intro.text: Straff Venture's illegitimate son, a Mistborn who hears a voice in his head urging him to kill and believes it means he is insane.
Straff Venture's illegitimate son and Elend Venture's brother, who serves his father while dueling Vin in the mists.

items.text: Zane had a hard childhood: because he was illegitimate, his father Straff kept his existence a secret.
At some point after he Snapped, Zane obtained a Hemalurgic spike and stabbed himself with it.

Zane carried out the missions Straff gave him, but often cut himself in front of his father, both to unsettle him and to drown out the voice telling him to kill Straff, since he believed a man should not kill his father. He did nothing to stop a serving girl who tried to poison Straff.

Zane watched Vin from afar and quietly helped her during a fight with a group of Allomancer assassins. Though on opposite sides, the two often met in the mists to duel and chase each other without truly trying to kill, and Zane kept telling Vin that Elend was using her.

Zane and Amaranta, his lover and Straff's former mistress, convinced Straff that Zane kept poisoning him, while her "antidote" was really an addictive drug whose withdrawal Zane exploited. Straff finally sent men to kill Zane in his sleep, but a man Zane had paid to watch his tent warned him and he escaped. He then left the camp to find Vin and take her away from Luthadel.

Zane came to Vin one last time and begged her to leave with him. She started to follow, then refused, realizing that Elend trusted her. Enraged, Zane attacked her with atium, repeating that she was supposed to save him. Vin used his reactions to her atium shadow to give herself two shadows and stabbed him in the neck. As he died, the voice told him he had never been insane.

appearance.text: Zane has his family's brown curly hair, kept short, a narrow face and a wiry build of medium height. He usually dresses all in black and, unusually for a Mistborn, does not wear a mistcloak.

personality.text: Shaped by a harsh upbringing, Zane is unstable and prone to self-harm.

Zane hears a voice that often tells him to kill everyone around him, and takes it as proof that he is insane. He refuses to let it rule him: he calls it God when he thinks of it, but otherwise ignores its orders.
Vin fascinates Zane from the start, as she is the only person the voice never tells him to kill, and he comes to believe she is meant to save him.
